$comment: One entry per Docker image. `routes` are the app/ folders the image owns (everything else under app/ is removed before `next build`); `paths` are the URL prefixes the router/ALB sends to it; `assets` are the runtime folders it needs on disk; `scheduler` marks the one image that runs the background workers. `common` is kept in every web image. Static assets of every image are served under /_fab/<image>/_next/* so several builds can share one origin.

home.description: Login, cockpit, account settings, auth and user endpoints. Default target for anything no other image owns (public/ files, favicon).

support-engineer.description: AI Support Engineer and FabInsight chat, reports, MCP connections, conversations, files and artifacts.

master-data-load.description: Modeling Agent: loader wizard, modeling chat, CMF package APIs. Needs the KSP templates on disk and, in AWS, the CMF VPC placement.

coding-agent.description: Coding Agent: requirement document to CMF deployment unit. Needs po-ui-assets/ on disk and a writable PO_UI_RUNS_DIR.

admin.description: Admin Console. Only image that carries the on-the-fly MCP deploy permissions (create Lambdas + secrets).

fabinsight.description: Scheduler process: compile jobs, dashboard refresh, expiry, alerts, baselines, shift summaries and the session-log retention sweep. No public route; only /api/health for the orchestrator.
